definitions.explanation: The state of applying oneself in earnest, after a period of half-hearted or preliminary work. Nearly always appears in the phrase {本腰|ほんごし}を{入|い}れる.

examples.japanese: ⟦そろそろ→そろそろ：01259_sorosoro⟧{本腰|ほんごし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れよう→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: It's about time to get serious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦{展開|てんかい}→展開：04542_tenkai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{本腰|ほんごし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れ→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: The company has begun to commit seriously to overseas expansion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧あと{一|いっ}か{月|げつ}になって、ようやく{本腰|ほんごし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧し⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: With only a month until the exam, he finally got down to studying in earnest.

notes:
USAGE:
The word is essentially bound to its collocation: {本腰|ほんごし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to get serious about). It is rarely used as a free-standing noun, and it implies a contrast with earlier half-hearted effort.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本腰|ほんごし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to get serious, to commit fully
- {本腰|ほんごし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧: to tackle something in earnest
- ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{本腰|ほんごし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: for the government to act in earnest

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{真剣|しんけん}→真剣：01565_shinken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become serious — about attitude at a moment, not sustained commitment
- ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put effort into — describes where resources go, without the "finally getting serious" nuance
